note: Anchor points that label the county's five UNNUMBERED board district shapes. The app fetches the county's live geometry and assigns each shape the district whose anchor it contains; if that is not a one-to-one match the layer refuses to label rather than guessing.
source: Macon County Clerk Josh Tanner, "Macon County Board Districts 2022" (colour-coded, legend numbering districts 1-5), supplied by e-mail 2026-08-07 and archived as data/source/raw/Macon County Board Districts 2022.pdf
